scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Ewam Anusuchit Janjati Civil Sewa Protsahan Yojana
other_conditions: Must have passed the preliminary examination of the Civil Services Competitive Examination conducted by either the Bihar Public Service Commission or the Union Public Service Commission.
Scheme benefit is available to each candidate only once.
Applicant should not have received the same incentive from any other sources previously.
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance of ₹50,000 for SC/ST candidates who passed the Bihar PSC preliminary exam, or ₹1,00,000 for those who passed the UPSC preliminary exam.
